40.
(1)  The  costs  of  and  consideration  received  for  a
liability of a person shall be determined in accordance with
sections 37 and 38 as though –

(a)
a reference to an asset were a reference to a liability;

(b)
expenditure  incurred  in  realising  the  liability  is
included in the costs of the liability; and

(c)
amounts derived in respect of incurring the liability
are included in the consideration received for the
liability.
(2) Subject to this Act, a person who owes a liability shall
be treated as realising the liability –

(a)
when  the  person  ceases  to  owe  the  liability,
